jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
jobs.description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use. When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law. Who

jobs.title: Lawyer
jobs.description: About us Omnilex started by building the AI workspace lawyers actually want to use, including the world's first AI-powered legal commentary, a living layer of legal understanding that redefines how lawyers work. In just one year, that product became the daily tool of thousands of legal professionals across Switzerland, Germany, and Liechtenstein, and a leading legal AI workspace in those markets. Now we are using that foundation to build something even bigger: the AI-native law firm. Every case our lawyers solve becomes a productized, AI-native service. Legal capability that scales, compounds, and can be deployed on demand for the next client. With a 4.5M raise, we're scaling this across Europe. You'll be joining a young, passionate, and dynamic team of 19. The role You are a lawyer, and you bring your book of relationships with you. You pick up real customer cases and solve them using Omnilex as your weapon. Then you do something almost no lawyer has ever done: you take what you just built and turn it into a productized, AI-native service that the next customer can run on demand. You own the customer end-to-end. You're the person they call, the person they trust, and the person whose name shows up when the contract gets renewed. The legal teams you work with are some of the most demanding in Europe, and they expect to talk to a lawyer. That's you. What you will do Solve the cases Pick up real customer matters. Do research, drafting, structuring arguments and deliver work product that holds up. Be the lawyer in the room when a customer hits a wall they cannot get over alone. Legal-engineer cases into AI-native services After each case, decompose what you did into reusable building blocks: prompts, workflows, templates, knowledge. Work with product and engineering to turn those blocks into services any customer can run on Omnilex. jobs.title: General Legal Counsel
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. jobs.description: Job Title: Senior Legal Counsel (Director) Location: Hybrid About Radiant Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software . As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace. Job Summary: We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel (Director) to join Radiant's Legal Team, working alongside and reporting to the General Counsel as one of the first lawyers in the business. You will take ownership of and lead on contractual negotiations and drafting of a wide range of agreements covering our customers and supply chain, plus areas of compliance and the development of new systems and processes. You will get to shape how the business operates and functions, allowing it to seize opportunities and grow rapidly, whilst managing risk, scaling sustainably and keeping clear long-term goals in focus. Strong technical legal skills are the bedrock of this role, combined with a strong sense of commercial judgment and the wider risk environment. The answers are not always clear or certain and being able to balance a range of factors and still give clear guidance or make a decision is part of this role. Your experience will ideally be built in commercial contracting within the data centre and AI space or, more generally, IT or technology, alongside developing or running in-house compliance programmes. jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
